assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game environment asset for FitFuel, a personal fitness journal with a customizable HUMAN avatar and a cozy 2.5D daily-life room. Make one cohesive high-quality original isometric cutaway small urban home gym / living studio, no characters. Wide 3:2 composition, orthographic three-quarter overhead view, entire diorama visible with breathing room, floor and walls occupy nearly the full image. A warm cream wall and large arched window at back left, sunlight casts soft diagonal patches over light honey oak plank flooring. Back left training corner: tidy compact dark sage workout bench, a low rack with a few realistic small dumbbells, rolled mint exercise mat, hanging towel, a water bottle. Back right: a small round oak dining table with a ceramic bowl of fruit, a plate and glass, two simple stools. Far right cozy rest corner: muted rust upholstered armchair with cream cushion, a small oak side table and warm reading lamp, a book and leafy plant. A couple of wall shelves and framed abstract botanical prints, quiet everyday domestic details, no clutter. Keep the central lower 40 percent of the floor completely EMPTY and walkable for a character to be composited later. Painterly polished game art, tactile rounded wooden furniture, bevelled clay-like forms, restrained handpainted textures, warm realistic materials, crisp readable silhouette, gentle ambient occlusion and soft shadows, not flat vector and not pixel art. Palette: warm ivory, honey wood, deep forest/sage green with small mint and terracotta accents. Lighting from top left. Plain very dark desaturated forest green outside the diorama, clean uniform background, no exterior landscape. No typography, no labels, no logos, no UI frames, no buttons, no watermark. No robot, no people, no mascot. The room needs to read beautifully on a 390px wide phone screen.
assets.normalization: resize and 256-color palette PNG, original alpha retained; no competitor art used

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production modular HUMAN avatar cutout sprite sheet for an original cozy 2.5D fitness-life game. Output exactly ONE square 4 by 4 atlas on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, 16 equal cells with generous invisible gutters, each part centered within its own cell, no grid lines, no labels and no text. It is a disassembled cutout puppet kit, NOT 16 complete characters. Each part has the exact same three-quarter orthographic view facing screen RIGHT, camera elevated slightly, same soft sunlight from upper left and consistent scale. Polished charming sculpted/handpainted game art with soft clay volume, crisp silhouettes and subtle dark brown outlines. HUMAN young adult, neutral feminine/masculine features suitable for personalized avatars, friendly small nose, expressive dark eyes, soft smile, warm medium-light peach skin, big rounded head with human ears and about 2.8-head-tall assembled proportions. Athletic casual clothing. Parts are smoothly rounded but anatomically human. Absolutely no robot, no visor, no armor, no mechanical joints. White/cream unprinted athletic T-shirt, charcoal shorts, white sneakers with mint details, dark chestnut hair. Keep skin parts a consistent peach tone and clothing mostly neutral to allow in-game color customization. EXACT CELL CONTENTS left-to-right, top-to-bottom: Row 1: (1) complete bald HUMAN head with face and ears, no neck and no hair; (2) short swept chestnut HAIR WIG only, shaped to sit on that head with a softly angled fringe, no face or scalp; (3) softly curly short chestnut HAIR WIG only, no face; (4) tied-back chestnut ponytail HAIR WIG only with a small elastic, no face. Row 2: (5) only the athletic white T-shirt TORSO from shoulders to waist, no head no arms, with short sleeve caps and neck opening; (6) only charcoal running SHORTS/hips from waist to mid thighs, no shins no shoes; (7) complete near-side peach ARM from shoulder to fingertips, naturally hanging down, no sleeve; (8) complete far-side peach ARM from shoulder to fingertips, naturally hanging down. Row 3: (9) near-side peach lower LEG/shin from shorts hem to ankle, no shoe; (10) far-side peach lower LEG/shin from shorts hem to ankle, no shoe; (11) near-side white mint-accent SNEAKER only, three quarter facing right; (12) far-side white mint-accent SNEAKER only, same view. Row 4: (13) soft shoulder-length chestnut HAIR WIG only; (14) a small fully ASSEMBLED REFERENCE of this exact friendly HUMAN avatar in the white shirt and charcoal shorts with short hair, 2.8 head tall, relaxed standing pose, no accessories; (15) one compact dark graphite DUMBBELL with a mint grip in the same view; (16) a small cream BOWL with simple colorful food and one spoon, same view. All human body parts must fit together as the SAME coherent person, no duplicate or extraneous limbs within a cell. No scenery, no floor, no background color, no fake checkerboard, no cast shadows outside parts, no crop at cell edges, no text, no logos, no watermark. The final sheet is for slicing and assembling by game code.
assets.normalization: resize and 256-color palette PNG, original alpha retained; no competitor art used
